description: Use NANOGrav pulsar sky positions and public ACT/Planck map products to test a PTA×κ sky cross-link proxy.

falsification_logic.confirm_like: pulsar-associated PTA proxy correlates positively with κ/density map values
falsification_logic.falsify_like: random sky rotations match or exceed observed correlation

warnings: Need parsed pulsar RA/Dec and ordinary FITS-WCS κ map. HEALPix maps are intentionally not sampled.
